headline: Google's 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark shows promise in automating everyday tasks, while Github Copilot's new billing model sparks controversy among developers
tldr: Today in AI, Google's Gemini Spark AI assistant demonstrates its utility in automating tasks, but its separate product status raises questions. Meanwhile, Github Copilot's token-based billing has drawn criticism from developers, and a new article highlights the limitations of embeddings in RAG retrieval. These developments underscore the evolving landscape of AI tools and the ongoing challenges in their development and deployment.

new_models.title: I put Google’s 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark to work, and it’s actually pretty useful
new_models.summary: Gemini Spark is a 24/7 AI assistant from Google that can automate various tasks, including inbox summaries and local event planning, but its status as a separate product is unclear
new_models.why_it_matters: This development matters because it showcases the potential of AI assistants in streamlining tasks and improving productivity, but also raises questions about the strategic decisions behind its release as a separate product

research.title: Embeddings Aren’t Magic: The Predictable Failure Modes of RAG Retrieval
research.summary: The article discusses the limitations of embeddings in RAG retrieval, including their failure to handle negation, exact identifiers, and company acronyms, and suggests alternative approaches
research.why_it_matters: This research is important because it highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of embeddings in AI applications, and encourages the development of more robust and effective retrieval methods

features_updates.title: ‘What a joke’: Github Copilot’s new token-based billing spurs consternation among devs
features_updates.summary: Github Copilot's new token-based billing model has drawn criticism from developers, who see it as a significant change from the previous pricing structure
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update matters because it reflects the ongoing evolution of AI tool pricing models and the potential impact on developer adoption and satisfaction
